title: The 'AI answers for members' switch and limit also govern gym web page visitors, but the owner is never told
what: The owner's section is called 'AI answers for members'. Its monthly limit says it gives members up to N answers a month, yet answers to gym web page visitors are taken from the same limit. Switching members off does not stop the web page helper from spending credits, and a busy web page can use up the members' monthly answers.
expected: The section says the limit is shared by members and web page visitors (or keeps two limits), and says that the members switch does not turn off the web page helper, pointing to where that switch is.
who: owners whose gym web page AI helper is on
how_often: every month, once the web page AI helper is live
fix_line: Say plainly the limit covers members and web page visitors, and where to switch the web page helper off

title: The assistant's amount boxes turn a pasted 'Rs. 1500' into 0.15 rupees and cannot take paise
what: On the assistant's payment, expense and paid-now boxes, every character except digits and dots is thrown away. A pasted 'Rs. 1500' or 'Rs.1,500' keeps the dot after 'Rs' and becomes 0.15 rupees. Typing a dot is dropped at once, so 1500.50 cannot be typed key by key. Digits in Hindi script are dropped to nothing.
expected: 'Rs. 1500', 'Rs.1,500' and '1,500.50' all read as the right amount, and a dot can be typed.
who: owners recording a payment or expense through the assistant
how_often: whenever an amount is pasted with 'Rs.' or has paise
fix_line: Strip a leading Rs or rupee word before cleaning, and keep a typed dot in the box

title: A member added by asking the assistant never has a birthday, so birthday ideas and wishes skip them
what: The assistant's add-member card asks only for name, mobile, plan and amount paid; the birthday is never asked and the AI's request has no place for it. Birthday ideas on Today and the automatic birthday wish depend on it. In Crispy Curves 1 of 2 members already has no birthday.
expected: The add-member card offers an optional birthday box, or the done card says the birthday can be added on the member page.
who: owners who add members by asking
fix_line: Add an optional birthday box to the assistant's add-member card
